cells.gaps: The digital ministry's 2027 estimate, presented to the National Assembly on 25 October 2026, is lower than its 2026 envelope (GAB-006), so the money did not rise in the latest budget. No fund, levy or assigned tax is shown created, collecting or paying, and nothing held gives what was spent.
cells.note: The 2027 finance bill gives the digital ministry FCFA 37.2 billion against FCFA 53.7 billion in 2026, a fall in the latest budget, which holds the cell at stage 2 whatever else is held. The 2026 rise (GAB-002, GAB-004) is the budget before.
